title: AI capability evidence by task family
methodology: The presentation archive preserves benchmark version, evaluation date, tool access, reasoning effort, scaffold, source, and limitations. No composite capability score is calculated.

families.scope: Graduate-level science questions. The human expert reference is 81.3% on the selection-filtered Diamond subset; it is not the 65% expert figure from the full GPQA set.
families.conditions: Provider/model-card results; reasoning and tool conditions differ by row. Scores are not a common local-hardware evaluation.

families.metricLabel: Mean medal score across ML competitions
families.scope: Submitted agent systems are evaluated on machine-learning engineering competitions. The score summarizes medal performance; it is not a pass rate or proof of independent research discovery.
families.conditions: The leaderboard evaluates full agents with tools and scaffolding. The model field names the submitted system, not only its underlying language model.

families.metricLabel: Human task duration at 50% agent success
families.scope: The p50 horizon is the estimated duration of tasks the tested agent system completes 50% of the time, measured against human task-time estimates.
families.conditions: Agent scaffold results on a suite concentrated in software, machine learning and cybersecurity. This is not standalone-model runtime or a general intelligence measure.
